howToCall: activated:false: direct wrappers may be unavailable. Use tools:invoke {name:"<exact tool name from hits>", args:{...}}. This result includes `servingGeneration`; pass it unchanged as `servingGeneration` to tools:invoke. Dispatch refuses a different or unknown server generation before the target runs. Exact names are prioritized; if `omittedTools` is present, query each listed name individually.
